title: 8 Best Safari Camps in Chobe 2026
description: The best safari camps and lodges in Chobe National Park, Botswana — curated from real Reddit reviews. Riverfront lodges, mobile camps, budget picks & luxury escapes.

places.name: Chobe Game Lodge
places.whatToOrder: What to book:A river-facing room for sunset views over the Chobe floodplain. Don't miss the boat cruise — you'll see elephants swimming, hippos surfacing, and African fish eagles hunting from water level. The all-female guiding team is exceptional.

redditQuotes.text: Chobe Game Lodge occupies an enviable riverfront location within Chobe National Park and boasts well-earned 'eco' credentials. It's the only permanent lodge inside the Chobe Riverfront area.
The amazing rooms, facilities and service coupled with the best views and largest concentrations of game in Botswana — we really do like this place. It's perfect for a 2 or 3 night stop.

places.insiderTip: The undisputed king of Chobe. Being inside the park means you're first out on game drives before the day-trippers arrive. The all-female guiding team is a genuinely special touch — trained and passionate. Expensive, but you're paying for the best location in Chobe. Book during green season for significant savings.

places.name: Chobe Chilwero
places.whatToOrder: What to book:The spa is world-class — book a treatment between game drives. Rooms have private plunge pools with panoramic river views. The cuisine is outstanding for a bush camp. Great value in low season (January–June and after November).

redditQuotes.text: Option number one is Godwana tours with Stanley's Camp, Nokanyana Lodge and Chobe Chilwero Lodge... we don't like crowds.
redditQuotes.source: — r/Botswana ·Help me choose between Botswana lodges, 2025

redditQuotes.text: For those wanting the same luxurious accommodation in Chobe, you need look no further than Chilwero. Great views, great service and absolutely stunning rooms.

places.insiderTip: The most refined lodge in the Chobe area. Perched on a hilltop above the river, the views are cinematic and the spa is genuinely world-class. Yes, it's pricey during peak season — but low season rates (Jan–Jun) can be surprisingly reasonable. Perfect for honeymooners or anyone who wants luxury between game drives.

places.name: Muchenje Safari Lodge
places.whatToOrder: What to book:Ask for a room with direct floodplain views — elephants regularly pass below the lodge. Muchenje is the only Chobe lodge offering walking safaris and night drives. The sundowner spot overlooking the Chobe floodplain is legendary.

redditQuotes.text: An old favourite of ours… Muchenje has the best views of any Chobe lodge and we love that it is a privately-owned lodge located away from the crowds. Significantly more economical than the other good lodges elsewhere in Chobe.
Along with all the other activities — boating, game drives etc — you can also walk and do night drives. Muchenje is the only lodge in the park where this is possible.

places.insiderTip: The smart money pick. Privately owned, intimate, and dramatically cheaper than the big-name lodges — without sacrificing quality. The views over the Chobe floodplain are arguably the best in the entire area. Walking safaris and night drives are huge bonuses you won't get elsewhere. If we had to pick one lodge in Chobe, this would be it.

places.name: Ngoma Safari Lodge
places.whatToOrder: What to book:Every suite has a private plunge pool — a rarity at Chobe price points. The quieter western location means far fewer vehicles on game drives. Perfect as a 2-night stay before heading to the busier riverfront area or onward to Victoria Falls.

redditQuotes.text: Set in the quieter part of the park — in the Chobe Forest Reserve — it benefits from the incredible wildlife of the national park but without sharing sightings with loads of other tourists. It also has private plunge pools — but for half the price you would pay in the Okavango Delta.
Honestly.. They are all pricey and good places. The ones you found are probably good.
redditQuotes.source: — r/Botswana ·Help me choose between Botswana lodges

places.insiderTip: The escape-the-crowds pick. Chobe's biggest drawback is vehicle congestion during peak season — Ngoma solves that by sitting in the quieter Forest Reserve. Private plunge pools at half the Okavango Delta price is a genuine steal. The tradeoff is a longer drive to the main riverfront, but for many travelers that's the whole point.

places.name: Chobe Under Canvas
places.whatToOrder: What to book:The full andBeyond package includes game drives, boat cruises, all meals and drinks. The camp moves every 5 days within the park, so you get a fresh wilderness experience. Fall asleep to the sounds of hippos and hyenas right outside your tent.

redditQuotes.text: Chobe Under Canvas certainly lives up to the reputation. Overall a truly stunning mobile camp remarkably similar to the style and character of East Africa's mobile outfits, but this one is always based on the Chobe River. We love it — the lodge's value is undeniable.
Luxury glamping camp. Prices start from around $650–$1,090 per person, per night.
redditQuotes.source: — Helen in Wonderlust ·Chobe Safari Lodges Guide

places.insiderTip: The adventure pick. andBeyond's reputation for exceptional guiding and food is fully earned here. Sleeping in a luxury tent inside the national park — with nothing between you and the African bush — is an experience a permanent lodge can't replicate. The mobile camp format means fewer guests and a more intimate safari. Worth every penny if you want the real deal.

places.name: Chobe Safari Lodge
places.whatToOrder: What to book:The river-facing rooms for sunset views. Book the Jacana boat cruise through the lodge — travelers say it's the best operator. The lodge has its own fleet for both game drives and river cruises. Good base for day trips to Victoria Falls.

redditQuotes.text: Incredible lodge right on Chobe River at the edge of the national park. Amazing daily river cruise — I would recommend booking these through the lodge. Great breakfast.

As far as large safari lodges go, this is the most convenient and best value in the Chobe area. The atmosphere is authentic and comfortable with a safari character. Located on the banks of the Chobe River, it offers arguably the best big river safari in Africa.

places.insiderTip: The no-brainer mid-range pick. Rated #1 in Kasane on TripAdvisor for good reason — it delivers excellent game viewing at a fraction of the luxury camp prices. Yes, it's a bigger operation, but that means reliable quality and great facilities. Perfect as a 2-night base before heading to more remote camps in the Okavango Delta.

places.name: Chobe Savanna Lodge
places.address: Namibian bank of the Chobe River
places.whatToOrder: What to book:Ask for a riverside suite for uninterrupted views across to Chobe National Park. The boat-based game viewing is the main draw — watch elephants, buffalo, and hippos from the water. The lodge focuses on relaxation — bring a book and a cold G&T.

redditQuotes.text: Chobe Savanna Lodge sits on the Namibian bank of the Chobe River, right at the northern tip of Chobe National Park. The main emphasis in the words of the camp manager is to 'chill down' — this lodge is definitely geared for that.
Relaxing at the lounge bar sipping a cold G&T while watching the game pass by is a fantastic way to start or finish a safari.

places.insiderTip: The unique angle here is the location — technically in Namibia, looking across the river into Botswana. You get Chobe's incredible wildlife but from a different perspective, literally. The vibe is deliberately relaxed rather than jam-packed with activities. Ideal for couples or travelers who want to decompress between more active safari days. Combine with a night or two at a busier Chobe lodge for balance.

places.name: Senyati Safari Camp
places.whatToOrder: What to book:The elephant bunker — it gets you incredibly close to the elephants that visit the waterhole daily. Self-catering chalets have everything you need. Camping sites with private ablutions are even cheaper. Bring your own food and drinks (there's a bar but no restaurant).

redditQuotes.text: Senyati is a self-catering camp with chalets and campsites. What makes this camp unique is that it has a waterhole that is frequented by elephants and other animals daily. They also have an elephant bunker so you can get really close to the animals.
redditQuotes.source: — Helen in Wonderlust ·Chobe Safari Lodges Guide

redditQuotes.text: We just did 13 nights using Kalahari Breeze agency. 7 nights camping, 6 in lodges. Amazing trip and what I considered reasonable price.
redditQuotes.source: — r/Botswana ·Opinions on Okavango Delta, Chobe, Nxai Pan, 2025

places.insiderTip: Proof that Chobe doesn't have to break the bank. The elephant waterhole alone is worth the stay — watching herds come in at sunset from the bunker is an experience that rivals any $1,000/night lodge. Self-catering means you control costs, and at 20km from Kasane you can still easily arrange game drives into the park. The backpacker's secret weapon for Chobe.
